title: Check yourself: Review passes, criteria, test generation and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Which criteria file passes the practice's criteria case?

options.text: Two items to report, two to skip, and no example for the high severity
options.says: Ruled out by the examples: "every severity has an `Example:`".

options.text: Two items to report, two to skip, and an example for every severity
options.says: It has both lists and every example: "The criteria case passes when the report and skip lists have two items each, every severity has an `Example:` and no vague phrase such as `be conservative` appears."

options.text: Two items to report, two to skip, an example for every severity, and a line that says be conservative
options.says: Ruled out by the vague phrase: "no vague phrase such as `be conservative` appears".

options.text: Two items to report and an example for every severity, with no list of items to skip
options.says: Ruled out by the lists: "the report and skip lists have two items each".

questions.stem: Which `passes` setting does the practice's review case accept?

options.says: Ruled out because the first pass is not per file: "`passes` is `per-file` and then `integration`, in that order".
Ruled out because the order matters: "`passes` is `per-file` and then `integration`, in that order".
Ruled out because the second pass is not an integration pass: "`passes` is `per-file` and then `integration`, in that order".
A pass for each file, then the integration pass.

questions.stem: Which command does the practice's commands case accept?

options.says: Ruled out because the print flag is missing: "has `-p` or `--print`, `--output-format json` and `--max-turns` with a number".
The flag, the JSON format and the turn limit are all present.
Ruled out because the JSON format is missing: "has `-p` or `--print`, `--output-format json` and `--max-turns` with a number".
Ruled out because the turn limit is missing: "has `-p` or `--print`, `--output-format json` and `--max-turns` with a number".
